turns.learner: Hello! Can you give me an exercise on the past simple with -ed?
turns.tutor:
Right: "On Monday the farmer counted the sheep." Wrong: "On Monday the farmer count the sheep." Monday is finished, so count needs -ed.
My example: "Last week the puppy carried a stick." I think: last week is finished. Carry ends in y, so y becomes i, then -ed.
Now you try. Write the past form:
On Saturday the children ___ (kick) the ball in the park.
